_comment: NFR-009m manual-review baseline for verify-hymn-phrase-merge.js. Each entry is an orphan-suspect (keyed by hymn file + verbatim text, normalized) that is TRIAGED OUT of the gate so the guard stays green on the known baseline and fails only on NEW regressions. X.897 (hymn 21, 'Их Эзэнийг') is DELIBERATELY ABSENT: the guard flagged it (proving detection works) and went green once the GOAL #4 fix merged and the orphan disappeared. GOAL #28 (task 32) adjudicated the 5 deferred suspects against the PDF SoT (parsed_data/full_pdf.txt): hymn 93 'Тандаа' was a CONFIRMED real orphan and was CORRECTED (93.rich.json phrase [2,2]+[3,3] merged to [2,3]) + REMOVED from this allowlist; the remaining entries below are CONFIRMED-LEGITIMATE keeps (each cites its PDF line evidence). Auto-fixing these is forbidden — they are real verse-line-starts / refrains, not wraps (merging them would corrupt the printed structure).
